en: ...Huh? Is this is a dead end?
Oh, an air duct...{PAGE}Yeah, this connects to the other side.{SAUT}I’m impressed you spotted this.
What!? You don’t mean...{PAGE}But there was a door on our way here―{SAUT}why don’t we check that first?
Yeah, you got a point. Welp, let’s head{SAUT}over to that door then.
C’mon, let’s go check out that door{SAUT}before messin' with this.
